mapper.insert: INSERT INTO interview_session (project_id, member_id, status, question_count) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{memberId}, 'IN_PROGRESS', 0)
mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.project_id, s.member_id, s.status, s.question_count, s.created_at, s.ended_at, p.repo_name FROM interview_session s JOIN interview_project p ON p.id = s.project_id WHERE s.id = #{id}
SELECT id, project_id, member_id, status, question_count, created_at, ended_at FROM interview_session WHERE project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
